edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address into _transfer.
Cooldown enforcement compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp.
Block.timestamp is supplied as the router swap deadline.
Block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transferFrom decrements the allowance of msg.sender.
approve grants allowance on behalf of msg.sender.
manualswap requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend requires msg.sender to equal _feeAddrWallet1.
setBots is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
delBot is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
setCooldownEnabled is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
removeStrictTxLimit is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
openTrading is guarded by onlyOwner which checks msg.sender.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender().
Public transfer forwards into the internal _transfer.
transferFrom forwards into the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements _allowances.
approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call.
swapTokensForEth passes tokenAmount into the external Uniswap swap call.
_transfer passes contractTokenBalance to swapTokensForEth.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH to external wallets.
sendETHToFee sends ETH via _feeAddrWallet1.transfer.
sendETHToFee reads _feeAddrWallet2 for the second transfer.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer which calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds reflection balances in _rOwned.
Reflected fees reduce _rTotal via _reflectFee.
_transfer checks bots[from] and bots[to] before proceeding.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee for the from/to addresses.
_transfer reads and updates the cooldown mapping.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer checks and lockTheSwap toggles the inSwap guard.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide whether to swap.
swapTokensForEth approves and calls uniswapV2Router.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap invokes swapTokensForEth with the contract balance.
manualsend invokes sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
openTrading adds liquidity through the external Uniswap router.
openTrading forwards owner() (derived from msg.sender) as the liquidity recipient.
swapTokensForEth indirectly relies on the reflection rate for the approved amount.
contractETHBalance local is read from address(this).balance during _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local is derived from balanceOf(address(this)).

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter is only consumed by transfer/transferFrom before flowing into _transfer.
amount parameter is only consumed by transfer/transferFrom before flowing into _transfer.
from parameter directly drives the state checks and accounting inside _transfer.
to parameter directly drives the state checks and accounting inside _transfer.
sender parameter is used by transferFrom to read and decrement the allowance.
bots_ array parameter is iterated by the owner-only setBots blacklist update.
notbot parameter is written into the bots mapping by delBot.
tokenAmount parameter is forwarded to the external Uniswap swap call.
contractTokenBalance local is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
contractETHBalance local is read from the contract balance inside _transfer.
currentRate local is derived by swapTokensForEth accounting for the token amount.
